execution_worker.interactive_mode_behavior: deprecated-global-mode; enforce per-task carrier before claim/phase-B

watchdog.interactive_mode_behavior: deprecated-global-mode; Broker remains available for unrelated autonomous tasks

result_time_semantics.completed_at: execution-local metadata; not authoritative for lifecycle ordering
result_time_semantics.lifecycle_order: derive from durable Git commit chronology and gateway commits
result_time_semantics.live_result: execution_mode=live binds result to carrier_id; lifecycle order is durable state/result chronology
result_time_semantics.live_partial_recovery: authoritative Git result commit time must not be later than the carrier lease expiry; result.completed_at is not used for recovery authority

task_carrier_policy.ownership_update: CAS on the same state.json projection used by scheduler claim
task_carrier_policy.live_acquire_precondition: state=queued, claim=null; carrier CAS races against scheduler claim on the same state object
task_carrier_policy.live_write_fence: fresh matching carrier_id + queued/unclaimed state + no same-task reserved/active gateway ownership
task_carrier_policy.live_completion: evidence-backed live result terminalizes state=completed and clears carrier before lease expiry
task_carrier_policy.inter_agent_live_execution: forbidden; historical live results are repair-only after carrier expiry
task_carrier_policy.explicit_hold: per-task hold blocks only that task without expiry

partial_completion_recovery.trigger: expired live carrier + queued/unclaimed state before scheduler claim
partial_completion_recovery.result_check: inspect result.json and authoritative Git commit time
partial_completion_recovery.valid_result: execution_mode=live, exact carrier_id/request digest/request blob/evidence, result commit not later than carrier lease expiry
partial_completion_recovery.action: CAS-repair state=completed with claim=null and carrier=null; for historical bounded_delegation also preserve pending caller continuation if already projected; do not execute target

caller_continuation_policy.manual_pull: no automatic caller continuation; verified child result stays durable until later Owner/caller retrieval
caller_continuation_policy.automatic_new_runtime: caller precreates a dependency-bound runtime:caller-continuation task; it targets the caller itself and executes only in a new Worker runtime after child success
caller_continuation_policy.historical_live_return: recovery-only after historical lease expiry in a fresh Worker runtime bound to the recorded caller

legacy_live_return_policy.creation: no new live return continuation may be created; only already-durable historical state or repair of a pre-migration live result is admissible
legacy_live_return_policy.recovery: after historical live_lease_until expires, a fresh Worker invocation may recover the pending continuation by binding that runtime to the recorded caller; no runtime may switch persistent agent_id

operational_status.reason: Observed Scheduled Chat runs can read GitHub but consequential GitHub mutations may be blocked by the platform safety layer before submission. Required wake/gateway/task writes therefore cannot be assumed available.
operational_status.prohibited_workaround: Do not weaken durable outbox, gateway fencing, task CAS, or runtime identity rules to compensate for an unavailable write actuator.
operational_status.allowed_separate_runtime_use: read-only Agent reasoning with bounded self-task result relay; no direct external writes
operational_status.relay_application_rule: Validate exact bounded relay bindings, persist the raw Agent-authored envelope unchanged, then acquire a short gateway fence only for mechanical persistence. The actuator must not reinterpret Agent judgment.
operational_status.resume_gate: Do not restore recurring autonomous Broker/Worker mutation service until the bounded relay lifecycle and a write actuator are each proven end-to-end without weakening fencing/identity invariants.
